title: Events and Background in a Story
goal: Tell a past story with the preterite for the events and the imperfect for the scene around them.
grammar: Events and background in the past

sections.title: Unit 2: Narrative Time and Aspect
body: At B2 you tell stories, not just single facts in the past. This unit is about how the past tenses build a story: which verbs move the plot forward, which ones paint the scene, and how to go further back in time.

You will practise the preterite and the imperfect together, the pluperfect, a few verbs that change meaning in the past, time connectors for stories and the imperfect as a polite form. The unit ends with a short text about the Mexican writer Juan Rulfo and his novel Pedro Páramo.

items: I can use the preterite for the events of a story and the imperfect for the scene around them.
I can tell which verb in a story moves the plot and which one describes.
I can use the new words for scenery and atmosphere.
